extraction.method: text layer of the filed PDF, read directly; no OCR, no transcription of numbers by hand beyond the verbatim block

doc.title: Infosys Limited and Subsidiaries — Consolidated Financial Statements under Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) for the year ended March 31, 2024

quotes.locator: page 1, Consolidated Balance Sheet, "Financial assets → Investments" (Note 2.5)
quotes.establishes: The only investment captions in the audited consolidated balance sheet are two "Investments" lines cross-referenced to Note 2.5; there is no "Investments accounted for using the equity method" caption in either year.
quotes.doesNotEstablish: It does not state what those investments consist of; Note 2.5 does.

doc.title: Infosys Limited and Subsidiaries — Consolidated Financial Statements under Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) for the year ended March 31, 2024

quotes.establishes: Note 2.5 decomposes both balance-sheet investment captions exhaustively into Ind AS 109 measurement categories (amortized cost, FVOCI, FVTPL) and reconciles arithmetically both ways. No equity-method (Ind AS 28) component exists inside them.
quotes.doesNotEstablish: It does not state in words that the Group has no associates or joint ventures; the conclusion follows from the completeness of the decomposition and from the statements, not from a nil declaration.

doc.title: Infosys Limited and Subsidiaries — Consolidated Financial Statements under Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) for the year ended March 31, 2024

quotes.amountQuoted: Total 404 (2024) / 365 (2023) across named preference, equity and fund holdings
quotes.establishes: Every named investee holding is a minority preference/equity stake or a venture-fund interest carried at fair value; none is described as an associate or joint venture and none is equity-accounted.
quotes.doesNotEstablish: It does not cover the financial-instrument holdings (bonds, G-secs, CDs, CPs, mutual funds) that make up the rest of Note 2.5 — those are not investee equity at all.

doc.title: Infosys Limited and Subsidiaries — Consolidated Financial Statements under Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) for the year ended March 31, 2024

quotes.establishes: The consolidation basis names the Company, its controlled trusts and its subsidiaries, and describes line-by-line consolidation with intra-group elimination; no associate or joint venture is named and no equity method is described.
quotes.doesNotEstablish: It is a policy paragraph, not a balance; it cannot by itself prove that no associate exists.

doc.title: Infosys Limited and Subsidiaries — Consolidated Financial Statements under Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) for the year ended March 31, 2024

quotes.locator: page 2, Consolidated Statement of Profit and Loss (complete)
quotes.amountQuoted: Revenue 153,670; other income 4,711; profit before tax 35,988; OCI lines as quoted
quotes.establishes: No "share of profit/(loss) of associates and joint ventures" line and no share-of-OCI-of-associates line appears, in either year — the presentation Ind AS 1 para 82(c) and Ind AS 28 require whenever an equity-accounted interest exists.
quotes.doesNotEstablish: It does not quantify any associate result; the point is that no such line exists.

doc.title: Infosys Limited and Subsidiaries — Consolidated Financial Statements under Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) for the year ended March 31, 2023

quotes.locator: page 1, Consolidated Balance Sheet, "Financial assets → Investments" (Note 2.5)
quotes.establishes: For FY2023 and FY2022 the audited consolidated balance sheet likewise carries no equity-method investment caption; the only investment captions are the two lines cross-referenced to Note 2.5, and both asset blocks agree with the filed totals.
quotes.doesNotEstablish: It does not describe the composition; Note 2.5 of the same document does.

doc.title: Infosys Limited and Subsidiaries — Consolidated Financial Statements under Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) for the year ended March 31, 2023

quotes.establishes: Note 2.5 for FY2023/FY2022 decomposes both investment captions exhaustively into Ind AS 109 categories and reconciles both ways; no equity-method component is present.
quotes.doesNotEstablish: As above: completeness, not a nil declaration.

doc.title: Infosys Limited and Subsidiaries — Consolidated Financial Statements under Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) for the year ended March 31, 2023

quotes.establishes: The named holdings for FY2023/FY2022 are the same financial investments (minority preference/equity stakes, venture-fund interests); no associate or joint venture appears.
quotes.doesNotEstablish: It does not cover the debt-instrument holdings.

doc.title: Infosys Limited and Subsidiaries — Consolidated Financial Statements under Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) for the year ended March 31, 2023

quotes.locator: page 2, Consolidated Statement of Profit and Loss (complete)
quotes.amountQuoted: Revenue 146,767; other income 2,701; profit before tax 33,322
quotes.establishes: No share-of-associates line in profit or loss and no share-of-OCI-of-associates line, in either year.
quotes.doesNotEstablish: It does not quantify any associate result.

doc.title: Infosys Limited and Subsidiaries — Consolidated Financial Statements under Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) for the year ended March 31, 2024

quotes.locator: pages 39-40, Note 2.19 Other income, net (complete note)
quotes.amountQuoted: Total other income 4,711 (2024) / 2,701 (2023); components: interest at amortised cost 1,007/955, interest at FVOCI 1,965/3, FVTPL gains 285/148, exchange 100/(647) and 87/1,062, miscellaneous 207/318
quotes.establishes: Note 2.19 is the only disaggregation of profit or loss beyond revenue and operating expenses, and therefore the note in which a share of an associate's or joint venture's profit would appear. Its complete component list is interest income, FVOCI interest, FVTPL gains, exchange gains and miscellaneous income — no equity-accounted share.
quotes.doesNotEstablish: It does not state that the Group has no associates or joint ventures; it establishes that no share of any such entity's result is recognised in profit or loss.

doc.title: Infosys Limited and Subsidiaries — Consolidated Financial Statements under Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) for the year ended March 31, 2023

quotes.locator: pages 39-40, Note 2.19 Other income, net (complete note)
quotes.amountQuoted: Total other income 2,701 (2023) / 2,295 (2022); components: interest at amortised cost 955/642, FVTPL gains 148/177, FVOCI interest 1/1, exchange gains (647)/88 and 1,062/186, miscellaneous 321/198
quotes.establishes: The same test one filing earlier: for FY2023 and the FY2022 comparative, other income contains no share of an associate's or joint venture's profit or loss.
quotes.doesNotEstablish: It does not state that the Group has no associates or joint ventures; it establishes that no share of any such entity's result is recognised in profit or loss for FY2023 or FY2022.

doc.title: Infosys Limited and Subsidiaries — Consolidated Financial Statements under Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) for the year ended March 31, 2024

quotes.period: FY2024 (2023 holdings in the comparative column)
quotes.locator: pages 50-52, Note 2.25 Related party transactions (roster, trusts, KMP)
quotes.unit: holdings in %; compensation in INR crore
quotes.establishes: The complete related-party universe has exactly three groups — subsidiaries (one list, every row 100%-owned or majority-owned and controlled, with "Under liquidation" markers on some subsidiaries), trusts including Infosys Foundation ("Trust jointly controlled by KMPs"), and key management personnel. No associates list and no joint-ventures list exists.
quotes.doesNotEstablish: It does not by itself rule out an associate that the Group failed to list; that is why the group-structure annexure and the balance sheet are also quoted.

doc.title: Infosys Limited and Subsidiaries — Consolidated Financial Statements under Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) for the year ended March 31, 2023

quotes.period: FY2023 (2022 holdings in the comparative column)
quotes.locator: pages 49-52, Note 2.25 Related party transactions (roster, trusts, KMP)
quotes.unit: holdings in %; compensation in INR crore
quotes.amountQuoted: Subsidiary holdings 100% / majority; KMP compensation 127 (145); the only entry under "List of other related party" is Infosys Foundation
quotes.establishes: Same three groups one year earlier — subsidiaries, trusts, KMP — with Infosys Foundation the only "other related party", for FY2023 and by comparative presentation for FY2022. No associates list, no joint ventures list, no equity-method transaction.
quotes.doesNotEstablish: It does not rule out an associate that the Group failed to list; that is why the group-structure annexure and the balance sheet are also quoted. It establishes only that no associate or joint venture appears among the related parties for FY2023 or FY2022.

doc.title: Infosys Limited and Subsidiaries — Consolidated Financial Statements under Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) for the year ended March 31, 2024

quotes.locator: pages 52-54, "Additional information pursuant to para 2 of general instructions for the preparation of Consolidated Financial Statements"
quotes.unit: INR crore and % of consolidated totals
quotes.amountQuoted: Infosys Limited 81.59% / 81,176; Indian Subsidiaries; Foreign Subsidiaries; Subtotal 100% / 99,492; consolidation adjustment (11,269); Controlled Trusts (107); Non-controlling interests 345; Total 88,461
quotes.establishes: The one table required to itemise the sources of consolidated net assets, profit or loss and OCI lists Infosys Limited, Indian Subsidiaries and Foreign Subsidiaries, then a 100% Subtotal, then the consolidation adjustment and controlled trusts. There is no associates block and no joint-ventures block.
quotes.doesNotEstablish: It does not name a nil for associates and joint ventures; it enumerates the Group's composition and leaves no block in which an equity-accounted entity could hide.

doc.title: Infosys Limited and Subsidiaries — Consolidated Financial Statements under Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) for the year ended March 31, 2024

quotes.locator: pages 31-57, Notes 2.13 to 2.27, note by note
quotes.establishes: Every note from 2.13 to 2.27 was opened and characterised: liabilities, payables, provisions, income taxes, revenue, other income, expenses, leases, employee benefits, EPS, contingent liabilities, related parties, segments and the function-wise classification. None discloses an associate, a joint venture, a dormant associate, an equity-method balance or a share of an associate's result.
quotes.doesNotEstablish: It does not re-read the interior movement tables of Notes 2.21 (leases) and 2.22 (employee benefits), pages 41-46; that limit is stated in the log itself and does not affect the question, since neither note can present an equity-accounted investment.

residualReview.scope: Notes 2.13 to 2.27 of the audited consolidated Ind AS statements, FY2024 and FY2023 filings, with FY2022 taken from the FY2023 comparative columns
residualReview.method: the filing is a digitally typeset PDF with a complete text layer; pages 31-57 were read through a full-document reader of the same PDF that does not truncate at 30 pages, page-anchored to the printed page numbers
